postings.text:
Home Careers Customer success engineer
Careers
Customer success engineer
Description
We are looking to hire technical members responsible for the customer success of Matlantis, a SaaS service provided by PFCC.
With the mission of "exploring the creation of innovative materials for a sustainable world," PFCC provides Matlantis, a versatile calculation engine, to help customers accelerate the development of new materials and the elucidation of their mechanisms.
Traditionally, first-principles calculations have not been able to perform a large number of trials due to their large computational cost. In the materials industry, it is common to discover materials through experimentation first and then perform first-principles calculations to elucidate phenomena later.
With Matlantis, the versatility and speed of Matlantis can be used to shorten the time required to validate experimental results in a variety of areas and to present promising candidates before experimentation.
PFCC offers Matlantis as SaaS. We do not only sell software licenses, but also accompany our clients to achieve real results by using Matlantis (customer success), which requires not only assistance in using Matlantis, but also technical expertise in discussing modeling and simulation methods, case studies, and other technical explanations. An explanation is also required. In addition, the project will support the customer's DX promotion.
Since the start of our business in July 2021, we have received interest from customers in a variety of industries, and we are receiving cutting-edge issues regarding the application of materials, the phenomena we handle, and the calculation methods, all of which will provide us with a variety of experiences. We are looking forward to receiving applications from enthusiastic individuals who are willing to learn and work in this challenging environment.
Tasks
- Customer Success: Discussing appropriate simulation methods for each customer issue, creating calculation examples, etc.
- Customer Support: Provide support to customers on how to better use Matlantis, answer questions about the system, etc.
- Business Efficiency: Selection and implementation of internal IT tools, formulation of business processes, etc
Requirements
Minimum
- Education: Bachelor Degree (Physics, Chemistry, and Materials science)
- Knowledge: Computer science
- Programming skills: Python language
- Preferred
Working Experience:
- Computational chemistry.
- For example, in-depth knowledge of and experience using simulation techniques such as quantum chemical calculations, molecular dynamics methods, electrical conduction calculations, etc.
- Research and development and writing papers on physical simulations.
- Research and development and writing papers in the field of Chemoinformatics and Materials Informatics
- In-depth experience and knowledge
- A specific materials field.
- In one's field of expertise
- Knowledge and proficiency with computational chemistry software and ancillary tools.
- In particular, ASE (Atomic Simulation Environment) software
- Other software, e.g. GAUSSIAN, VASP, LAMMPS, RDKit, Open Babel, etc.
Skills:
- Data analysis techniques using machine learning and statistical tools (e.g. NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, etc.)
- Market and customer analysis
- Engage the audience presentation
- English (discussion with clients, writing and reading skills)
※Matlantis is looking to expand overseas, those interested can get involved
Willing and ability
- Actively discussing with engineers from different fields and companies
- Following and following up on the latest publications
- Constantly learning new domain knowledge
- Smooth discussions with clients
Required documents in addition to a resume
- Paper list
Appeal
- It is possible to be involved in work with a high degree of social contribution, such as developing materials to achieve the SDGs.
- You can be involved in cutting-edge issues at top companies in various industries.
- As a start-up with a small number of employees, each individual has enormous scope and discretion in their work.
Type of Employment
Full-time employee, a probationary period of 3 months (same terms and conditions as the primary employment)
Location
Tokyo - Japan
Work schedule
- Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, national holidays, other (congratulation, condolence, year-end and New Year holidays)
- Full flextime system (no core time)
- Remote work is possible.
- Annual paid leave system by our company's regulations.
Compensation
- Compensation based on experience, performance, ability, and contribution
- Reviewed twice a year
- In addition to base salary, bonus based on company performance and individual performance (twice a year, in April and October)
- Transportation expenses paid (maximum 150,000 yen/month actual expenses paid; if exceeding the limit, a consultation will be required)
Welfare
- Social insurance (employee pension insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance, worker's accident compensation insurance)
- Paid vacations, maternity leave, childcare leave, congratulation or condolence leave, etc.
- Periodic health checkups
- Subsidy for purchase of laptop PC
- Smaller Enterprise Retirement Allowance Mutual Aid System

Home Careers Customer Success Engineer
Careers
Customer Success Engineer
Description
With the mission of "accelerating materials discovery for a sustainable future", PFCC provides Matlantis™, a versatile calculation engine, to help customers accelerate the development of new materials and elucidate their mechanisms.
Traditionally, first-principles calculations have not been able to perform a large number of trials due to their large computational cost. In the materials industry, it is common to discover materials first through experimentation and then via first-principles calculations to elucidate phenomena later.
The versatility and speed of Matlantis can be used to shorten the time required to validate experimental results in a variety of areas and to present promising candidates before experimentation.
PFCC offers Matlantis as SaaS. Not only do we sell software licenses but also accompany our clients to achieve meaningful results by using Matlantis. We provide support for how to use Matlantis, but also conduct professional technical explanations such as discussions on modeling and simulation methods and case validations. Moreover, we support the promotion of customers' digital transformation (DX).
Since the business started in July 2021, we have received interest from customers in various industries. We deal with cutting-edge issues in all areas, including the application of materials, phenomena handled, and computational methods, allowing us to gain a wide range of experiences. We look forward to applications from enthusiastic individuals who want to learn and advance their work in this challenging environment.
Responsibilities
Customer Success：
- Discuss and propose appropriate simulation methods and workflows for each customer issue, and create and provide computational case studies.
- Work closely with the product development team to reflect customer feedback in our products and to share our roadmap.
Requirements
Minimum
- Knowledge of basic computer science
- Programming skills using the Python language
- Experience and knowledge in a specific materials science field
- Experience in computational chemistry, for example, simulations involving quantum chemical calculations, molecular dynamics methods, electrical conductivity calculations, etc.
- Knowledge and experience using simulation techniques and tools, such as ASE (Atomic Simulation Environment) and LAMMPS
- Data analysis skills using machine learning and statistical tools (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn)
Preferred
- Experience in research and development, as well as writing papers on physical simulations
- Knowledge and proficiency in computational chemistry software and auxiliary tools
- Experience using software like GAUSSIAN, VASP, RDKit, Open Babel, etc.
- Experience in research and development, as well as writing papers in the fields of cheminformatics and materials informatics
- Ability to actively discuss with engineers from different fields and companies
- Ability to keep up with the latest research trends and replicate studies
- Deep insights and experience in one's area of expertise
- Willingness to constantly learn new domain knowledge
- Ability to engage in smooth discussions with customers
- Presentation skills that captivate an audience
- Market and customer analysis skills
- Passion for market expansion and exploration
- English language ability
- Japanese language ability
Required documents in addition to a resume
- Paper list
Appeal
- You can be involved in socially beneficial work, such as material development to achieve the SDGs.
- You can engage with cutting-edge challenges faced by various industry-leading companies.
- As a member of a small startup, you will have a large scope of responsibility and discretion.
- You can be involved as a stakeholder in the growth of a startup company.
- You can contribute to the global dissemination of software originating from Japan.
